description: SEC 10-K human capital & headcount — Pull the human capital section from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing=0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR: headcount (total, full-time, part-time) read from the company's own sentences with the quoted sentence for each number, disclosure depth DETAILED/STANDARD/MINIMAL, word count, topics covered (diversity & inclusion, turnover/retention, engagement survey, pay equity, training, health & safety, unions/collective bargaining, remote/hybrid, wellbeing, succession), the union, turnover and geography statements, and an excerpt. Use it for workforce size lookups, labor-risk screens (union coverage), employer research and peer comparison. ticker: stock ticker or CIK (e.g. AAPL). filing: optional, 0 = latest 10-K (default) up to 4. Headcount numbers come from the filing text, so check the quoted sentence. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
